Meet Chad Rempel

Rempel Removal starts with Chad, who brings a lifetime of hard work, leadership and community roots to every job.

Call 1 (647) 688-6978Text us a photo

From long snapping to junk removal

For 17 years, Chad owned and operated the first Booster Juice location in Saskatoon, on 8th Street. In those same years he played 17 seasons of professional football in the CFL and NFL as a long snapper.

As a long snapper, Chad learned that success comes down to doing the little things right: being consistent, dependable, disciplined and ready when your team needs you. Those values shaped how he built his business and how he works with people today.

Chad's family owned Rempel Brothers Construction for more than 60 years, building a legacy of hard work, trust and doing the job right. He's proud to carry that forward with Rempel Removal.

Whether it's a garage packed to the ceiling, a pile of demolition debris or a full property cleanout, Chad and his team will have it gone in a snap.
